sentences.text: This is first bail application u/S.439 of the Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

T h e applicant has been arrested on 29.01.2024 by Police Station- Kasrawad, District Khargone in connection with Crime No.543/2023, registered in relation to the offence punishable under sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.

2 MCRC-20079-2024 A s per prosecution story, on 28.11.2023 mother of the prosecutrix/complainant lodged a missing person's report at P.S. Kasrawad, District Khargone alleging that on 27.11.2023 at about 8:00 AM when her minor daughter/prosecutrix, who is aged Karan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79821269/
1 about 16 years had gone along with her younger sister and other girls outside the village for answering the nature's call and she did not returned back and went missing.

sentences.text: They tried to search her everywhere, but she could not be found.
During the investigation, it got revealed that co-accused persons have abducted and took the prosecutrix with them and had committed rape upon her.
On the basis of aforesaid, the crime has been registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 29.01.2024.
He is not the main accused, who has committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
There is no legal evidence available on record to connect the applicant with the aforementioned offence.
Investigation is over and charge- sheet has been filed.
Applicant is a permanent resident of Khargone district.
Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and also taking note of the fact that the applicant is not the main accused,
who has committed rape upon the prosecutrix, investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed,
therefore, no further custodial interrogation of the applicant is 3 MCRC-20079-2024 required, in view of the limited role attributed by the applicant, without commenting upon the merits of the case,
I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, the application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) V. JUDGE Anushree Karan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79821269/
